notes: Planar double compound pendulum with two uniform rigid rods. Angles measured from downward vertical; q2 is relative to link 1. Observations are joint positions only (no velocities). The mass of link 1 (m1) is known from direct measurement. The remaining physical parameters (m2, l1, l2, b1, b2) and initial angular velocities (qd1_0, qd2_0) are unknown and must be estimated.
